excerpts: Rideshare and taxi lanes are located directly in front of Denver Union Station off Wynkoop Street.
Rideshare pickup and drop-off typically take place on the west side of Denver Union Station near the Wynkoop Street entrance.
Always check your rideshare app for the exact pin location during pickup.

excerpts: Street and metered parking is available in downtown Denver on a first-come, first-served basis.
Denver Union Station does not have a dedicated parking lot.
